## Why these notes exist

The old topics haven't left and the new ones have arrived on top of them. Data
governance and data quality are still the entry ticket; ontologies are moving
from artisanal modelling to maintained assets; and LLM-assisted KB generation
and GraphRAG are now where the arguments happen.

Rather than let three days of notes rot in a notebook, I'm putting them here —
one page per talk, each one marked up with [schema.org](https://schema.org)
structured data, because writing about knowledge graphs without publishing any
would be a poor look.

> **Caveat.** These are my notes, not a transcript. Any misreading of a
> speaker's argument is mine. Where I could, I've linked the official abstract
> and the slides — go there for the authoritative version.
